facts.fact: The education minister's start-of-year circular of 1 September 2025 makes consolidating the SIGE, through the GOSE and SMIS platforms, a priority strategic axis for 2025-2026, so as to produce regularly updated data, identify pupils at risk and make individual pupil follow-up a key instrument; it is a ministerial circular, not a costed plan.

La Nation reports that the Ministry of National Education and Vocational Training itself directs the SIGE and its GOSE and SMIS platforms, through the minister's circular of 1 September 2025 to all staff of the sector.
